name: Lion Travel Service Co., Ltd.
summary: Lion Travel Service Co., Ltd. provides travel services in Taiwan and internationally. It operates through the Travel Department and Others segments. The company organizes domestic and foreign sightseeing tours. It also provides related services, such as arranging accommodation and meals for tourists; receiving domestic and foreign tourists and arranging accommodation and meals and tour guides; accepting entrustment to sell domestic and foreign transportation tickets; purchasing domestic and foreign tickets on behalf of customers; baggage check-in; and handling entry and exit visa procedures.
